title: One-dimensional chess on a Möbius strip: an idea on Tuesday evening, a playable link on Wednesday evening
summary: On Tue 17 Nov 19:03Z @mokkenstorm.dev (423 followers) posted: "3 player 1d chess on a Möbius strip wormed its way into my brain and now I need to build it". At 22:23Z the same account quote-posted @yonderdavid.bsky.social's polyhedra-instruments video with a picture of a ring of chess pieces: "I hope you don't mind I borrowed your colour scheme for inspiration for 1 dimensional mobius chess" (36 likes). @minormobius.bsky.social (7,162) replied "That’s awesome, I need a website tho"; the maker answered "👩‍🍳 cooking..". @chromacollector.bsky.social (69 followers) replied "i can’t even imagine how tf this plays"; the maker answered that a playable link was coming "(soon)" and added a video: "and.. yknow, like this. With ghosts and ninjas". @minormobius.bsky.social replied to the promise, "I’m so happy rn you have no idea", and, to a question from another member, "I like! I repost! But I’m not gonna love unless there’s a link". At Wed 18 Nov 20:29Z, 25 hours 26 minutes after the first post, the maker replied with the link: "mobius.mokkenstorm.dev" and "sneaky preview on a cloudflare tunnel". Reply: "Fuuuuuck that’s so goooood". The maker: "It’s multiplayer and agent friendly 👀", and a minute later a link to the page's llms.txt. The digest records the page's title as "ringmate". Two unsolicited promotional replies offering to build a website arrived under the request for a website; the maker answered one "Bad bot, please notify your operator that showing up uninvited is rude?" and the other "Bad bot".
